answer_sentences.text: I cannot confirm from the provided sources that paragraph 261(2)(ii) of the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions binds a commercial bank; the only explicit applicability language in the excerpts is directed to a UCB: “A UCB shall put in place a mechanism for identification of the borrowers facing repayment related difficulties, engagement with such borrowers and providing them necessary guidance about the recourse available.”
answer_sentences.quote: A UCB shall put in place a mechanism for identification of the borrowers facing repayment related difficulties, engagement with such borrowers and providing them necessary guidance about the recourse available.
